question: Which was the first talkie movie made in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Alam Ara__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alam Ara** is the **first talkie movie**(sound film) made in India.

 
 
• It was directed by **Ardeshir Irani.**
 
• **Alam Ara** was released on **14 March 1931.**
 
• The film tells the love story between a prince and a gypsy girl.
 
• The movie was inspired by the American film '**Show Boat'** in 1929.
 
• **Prithviraj Kapoor **played the lead role in **Alam Ara** movie.
 
• A song from this movie "**De De Khuda Ke Naam Per**“, was the first playback song in Indian cinema.
 
• As per official data, there is no known copy of the film anymore.
 
• It was for the first time that **78 actors recorded** their voices for the movie.
 
• Google celebrated the 80th anniversary of the film's release by publishing Google Doodle on 14 March 2011.
 
 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kisan Kanya** is the first indigenously made color film in India.

 
 
• It was directed by Moti Gidwani.
 
 
 
• **Raja Harishchandra** is the first full-length feature film in India.
 
 
• It was directed and produced by Dadasaheb Phalke.
 
 
 
• **Mother India** is the first Indian film to be nominated for Academy Award for Best International Feature Film.
 
 
• It was directed by Mehboob Khan.
